name: EZFlora
description: The EZFlora 5010A 8-zone irrigation controller from Compacta International, sold by SimpleHomeNet and Smartenit: valves, programs, the Sprinkler Control sub-commands, timer banks, the configuration register and the water meter count.

standardCommands.name: setAddressMsb
standardCommands.description: Set Address MSB: sets the high byte of the address Peek and Poke use, 0x00 for the EZFlora's own locations and 0xFF for the ALL-Link database.

standardCommands.name: poke
standardCommands.description: Poke One Byte: writes a timer, in minutes, to the location Peek One Byte last set, then moves to the next location.

standardCommands.name: peek
standardCommands.description: Peek One Byte: sets the timer location to cmd2 and reads the timer there. Only the address's low byte is used. Locations 0x00 to 0x07 hold the manual timers of valves 1 to 8, 0x08 to 0x0F program 1's, 0x10 to 0x17 program 2's, 0x18 to 0x1F program 3's and 0x20 to 0x27 program 4's.

verification.note: The EZFlora Insteon and X10 Messages/Commands give 0x00 through 0x27 in the command table and 0x00 through 0x2F in their note on timer locations, which lists banks only up to 0x27; the catalog uses 0x00 through 0x27.

verification.note: The EZFlora Insteon and X10 Messages/Commands give no unit for these timers; minutes is read from Poke One Byte, whose timer values they give in minutes and which writes the same locations.

notes: Every Sprinkler Control sub-command's acknowledgment carries the valve status byte. For an invalid valve or program, ON commands return 0x00 and OFF commands 0xFF.

Status Changed broadcast (cmd1 0x27): with Enable Valve Status Change Message, the EZFlora broadcasts when a valve turns on or off during a program, but not after a direct valve command; with Enable Meter Count Change Message, it broadcasts when the meter count changes. The To Address carries the status byte in its high byte and the meter count's high and low bytes in its middle and low bytes.

The EZFlora answers an ID Request with an acknowledgment and a SET Button Pressed broadcast, and a Ping (cmd1 0x0F) with an acknowledgment. Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09) is the same as holding the SET button 4 seconds, and Enter Unlinking Mode (cmd1 0x0A) as holding it 10 seconds. ALL-Link Recall (cmd1 0x11, an ALL-Link command) recalls groups 0 to 15.
Configuration register bit 2 isn't documented. Bit 7 of the register and bit 6 of the valve status byte both show the pump option.

X10: units 1 to 8 turn valves 1 to 8 on and off; units 9 to 12 start and stop programs 1 to 4; unit 13 On inhibits commands and Off resumes them; unit 14 On skips forward and Off skips back; unit 16 On enables the pump on V8 and Off disables it.

The accessory connector (RJ-45) isn't for data: pin 1 input 1 (not used), pin 2 +5 V auxiliary (50 mA maximum), pins 3, 5 and 7 ground, pin 4 water meter pulse input (with a built-in pull-up), pin 6 rain sensor (must be pulled up to inhibit), pin 8 no connection.
